messages:
maria_support: Hey team — BrightLane hit intermittent 504s on /v1/generate (streaming) starting ~03:40 UTC. Customer says stream cuts off after a few chunks, SDK retries, and they see duplicate token billing. Repro snippet below and a sample trace attached.

maria_support: repro (from their env):
```bash
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"...long prompt...","stream":true}' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria_support: sample trace lines they provided:
```
trace_id=brt-01a  level=info  upstream=edge-1  msg=\"request start\" latency=0.002
trace_id=brt-01a  level=warn  upstream=svc-infer-7 msg=\"read timeout from upstream\" err=\"upstream read timeout (110)\" elapsed=18.4s
trace_id=brt-01a  level=info  upstream=edge-1  msg=\"responding 504\"
```

liam_dev: Thanks. Are they on HTTP/2 multiplexing in the new SDK or plain HTTP/1.1? 504 after ~18s smells like an upstream read timeout. Any client-side network retries configured?

maria_support: They use our JS SDK v0.9 with http2 enabled (multiplex:true). Default client retry policy kicks in after stream cutoff (hence duplicate billing). Concurrency per client ~40 streams.

raj_eng: Multiplex + many long-lived streams can exhaust keepalive slots on the edge -> upstream connections become hot and hit queue/backpressure. We also had a small canary bump of keepalive settings earlier today (03:15 UTC). Can you share p95/p99 connection counts and edge active streams at spike?

maria_support: p95 active streams at spike ~2200, p99 ~4800. Edge reported SYN backlog spikes. Attach snippet of edge metrics: active_connections=4700, idle_keepalive=120, epoll_wait=high.

sarah_oncall: @raj_eng could this be the earlier canary? If so, we should revert or apply a hotfix. @deploy-bot any deploys around 03:10-03:30?

deploy-bot: canary/edge-config v2.14 rolled at 03:12 UTC to 10% of hosts (pipeline id: deploy-4482). No errors flagged during rollout.

raj_eng: Yep that's in the window. Hypothesis: changed keepalive->idle timeout + increased max concurrent streams per connection interacts poorly with HTTP/2 flow control, causing HEAD-of-line when many long streams stall. Two mitigations: 1) roll back canary to previous keepalive settings 2) throttle per-client concurrent streams at edge for hosted tier.

liam_dev: For short-term repro, I can run a local storm reproducer that opens 1k multiplexed streams with long-tail chunking. I need credentials to target a staging edge with the canary on.

maria_support: Created a staging customer token and shared in #sec-safe. Also asked BrightLane to test a temporary client-side change: set sdk.multiplex=false and reduce concurrency to 8. They reported no 504s after that for 30m.

nate_account: Customer is upset — they reported duplicate billing from SDK retries. CS asked for a status note and a partial credit. Suggest we confirm root cause then propose a credit for the duplicate tokens during spike window.

sarah_oncall: Immediate action items:
- @deploy-bot: roll back edge-config canary from 10% to 0% across hosts (hot rollback).
- @raj_eng: enable extra proxy debug logs for http2 window and conn reuse on the impacted frontends for 1 hour.
- @liam_dev: run reproducer against staging and post results.
- @maria_support: send templated interim customer update (we'll offer temporary credits).

deploy-bot: rollback of canary/edge-config v2.14 scheduled now. Progress: 10% -> 0% (initiated). Will update once finished.

raj_eng: Debug logs enabled on the 6 frontends that saw highest error rates. Early tails show many streams hitting stalled WINDOW_UPDATE and then the proxied upstream read timeout. Putting a short-term mitigation: reduce per-connection max-concurrent-streams from 100 to 16 on edge (will be a config flip).

liam_dev: Reproducer results: with multiplex:true + concurrency=40 I can reproduce 504s in ~40s on staging with the canary settings. With multiplex:false or concurrency<=8, stable. I'll attach the test script in the incident doc.

maria_support: Drafted customer note: \"We're actively investigating. We've rolled back a recent edge config change and applied a mitigation to reduce per-connection multiplexing. We recommend updating SDK to set multiplex:false or reduce concurrency while we finish root cause. We'll follow up with a billing credit for duplicate retries.\"

nate_account: Good. Please include exact window for credits (03:40-03:58 UTC) and estimate impacted tokens once repo data available.

sarah_oncall: Follow-ups: raj to gather full postmortem, liam to post reproducer + steps, maria to send CS update now and follow up when billing numbers ready. Closing on next update in 30 minutes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_support: Sent interim update to BrightLane and scheduled billing analysis. Will post final status when rollback + mitigation metrics look stable.
